name: SynTReN external input table
description: SynTReN predefined external-input table consumed when externalInputValues=FROM_EXTERNALS_FILE. Rows are external regulator genes and columns after Regulators are expression experiments or perturbation conditions.
example:
Regulators	exp1a	exp1b	exp2a
cytR	0.1	0.1	0.5
rpoE_rseABC	0.1	0.8	0.1
validation_notes: Every column after Regulators must be numeric and is interpreted as one public perturbation/sample column.
Every regulator in the table must exist in the selected SynTReN source network and qualify as an external node for the upstream run.
When this input is used, the wrapper must set fixedExternals=true, selectSubnetwork=false and externalInputValues=FROM_EXTERNALS_FILE.
